requiredFindings.title: Make the mount setup satisfy its own mountinfo invariant
requiredFindings.problem: Overmounting the inherited writable cgroup2 view retains that covered mount in mountinfo. The subsequent all-cgroup2-entries predicate therefore rejects the ordinary delegated runner.
requiredFindings.impact: The prescribed clean setup cannot produce the expected complete calibration or memory samples; it fails closed as isolation-unverified.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Remove inherited cgroup mounts and aliases in the private mount namespace before installing the leaf-only read-only view, or specify a sound check of reachable mount topology. Include the ordinary inherited writable mount as a successful setup case and preserve writable-alias rejection.
requiredFindings.evidence: Static inference from documented stacked-mount enumeration, not an executed demonstration.

requiredFindings.title: Make pre-creation failures and no-leaf settlement representable
requiredFindings.problem: Batch host checks can produce escape-unprevented or isolation-unverified before a leaf exists, but the absent-leaf carrier forbids those reasons and calls them post-creation. The elapsed definition also unconditionally requires populated 0 although legitimate unavailable Linux/macOS slots have no leaf and retain elapsed.
requiredFindings.impact: Declared incomplete outcomes lack a truthful witness/end condition, forcing invented leaf evidence, invalid envelopes, or loss of known elapsed values.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Define creation/failure order and actual created-versus-absent evidence. Either guarantee creation before the relevant checks when possible or allow the applicable pre-creation absence reasons. Define no-leaf elapsed settlement using root/descendant reaping independently of cgroup interfaces. Update ENV, validator and reference cases while preserving QD-27 known values.
requiredReferenceCases: batch-start isolation failure before leaf creation
unavailable Linux with known elapsed and absent leaf
macOS with known elapsed and absent leaf

nonBlockingObservations.title: Make non-dumpability a continuous prerequisite
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Non-dumpability correctly restricts ptrace-gated proc access for ordinary credentials while effective. Define the outside harness/driver process set and maintain that prerequisite throughout the interval. Ordinary exec resets dumpability before new-image userspace; post-exec restoration or polling leaves a window. No explicitly permitted outside exec defeats the stated invariant, so this is clarification rather than another required finding.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Account for the audit's own descriptor
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Listing proc/self/fd opens a temporary directory descriptor. Exclude only that identified audit descriptor and close it before exec, or audit externally from the parent; the final inherited set must still be exactly the three pipes.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Pin AQP6 to the matching accepted snapshot
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The live accepted PLAN.md now has hash 1611014d4b8b71e3c3ce28274d6423114d0a2f54ae3a72990f7476c2ca043480 and a two-line acceptance-note shift. PLAN-r6.md has the stated 8aed6eb8461592f68575b672d4f79248cded9c869a4ff124964aaffbc9a2f9f1 hash and the intended line numbers. Point AQP6 at that retained snapshot. Plain AQP and ENV's corrected r5 citations are sound.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Make complete-row baseline compatibility checks explicit
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The general compatible-basis rule should compare reset/cache/charge-ownership policy and kernel as well as the enumerated metric, runner class and entry method. Qualify otherwise-no-baseline to complete rows; any slot reason continues to take precedence as incomplete. The metric mismatch from r9 is resolved.

priorFindingAssessment.resolution: Descriptor closure/audit and stated sole-writer, mount and non-dumpable prerequisites address the two former access paths. The prescribed overlay cannot satisfy its all-mountinfo check; R10-01 remains.
Entry establishes placement rather than charge transfer. External/shared/inherited ownership limits are explicit and the universal RSS bound is withdrawn.
Independent driver cgroupLeaves fixes missing operational records and the four declared absence reasons. R10-02 covers pre-creation reasons and no-leaf elapsed settlement.
The RSS denominator is removed, charged baseline and reviewed basis digest are required, and absolute RSS-budget comparison remains informational until D13.
ENV and plain AQP now cite the pinned r5 snapshot correctly. The new AQP6 live-file pointer has N03.
Subreaper, root reaping, ECHILD and populated 0 define settlement and elapsed end; timeout invalidates both values. R10-02 covers the newly introduced no-leaf end-condition gap.

requestAssessment.isolation: Sound in principle under sustained mount/descriptor/non-dumpability and sole-writer prerequisites, but the exact setup/check sequence needs R10-01.
requestAssessment.nonDumpable: The kernel guard is appropriate while effective. No additional concrete false-complete case was established under the sustained prerequisite; N01 makes its lifetime explicit.
requestAssessment.schema: Static inspection: 41 closed object schemas, integer-only numeric fields and no unresolved local references. Created/absent leaf oneOf is internally consistent; the permitted absence reasons and lifecycle need R10-02.
requestAssessment.nulling: Isolation-unverified invalidates memory only. Failed run, timeout and failed settlement invalidate both. Missing operational evidence keeps known samples, and any reason remains incomplete and excluded from Q6.
requestAssessment.qualification: RS3 remains unchanged. Charged Q6 values remain exploratory; D13 decides equivalence to qualification RSS.

scopeAssessment.description: Full retained-r9 comparison fits the response table: isolation, metric wording, driver leaf evidence, baseline carrier/basis, settlement, citations and their reference cases.

verification.method: Read-only full DESIGN/schema comparison, hash/size checks, static carrier/validator/citation inspection, three independent challenge slices and primary Linux documentation/source inspection.
